summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a 6-K on May 14, 2026, announcing a definitive arrangement agreement to acquire all shares of Vizsla Royalties Corp for C$4.13 per share (total ~C$327M / US$239M). Consideration mix: 0.15 Elemental shares, cash of C$4.13, or a combination, with max cash ~C$82M. The price represents a 31% premium to the unaffected close and 22% to the 20-day VWAP as of May 12, 2026. The transaction is a court-approved plan of arrangement (Canadian equivalent of a statutory merger). Vizsla's key asset is a 2.0%-3.5% NSR royalty on the Panuco silver-gold project. Elemental expects Panuco to add ~7,500 GEOs/year. A joint conference call is set for May 14, 2026. Watch for shareholder and court approvals, and proration on cash/stock election.
